# Pro Blog Starter Kit

> Open-source, Obsidian-inspired starter kit for launching a fast, free personal blog on GitHub Pages using Hugo or Jekyll, modular plugins (Giscus comments, SEO/GEO pack, Obsidian template, RSS-to-Profile sync, Math/Mermaid, GoatCounter), and a live Web Configurator.

- [Live Web Configurator](https://cmduyeen.github.io/pro-blog-starter-kit/)
- [Main Guide](README.md)
- [Contributing Themes & Plugins](CONTRIBUTING.md)

Use `python setup.py` for the interactive wizard, or `python setup.py --list` to inspect all themes and plugins.
